faqs.q: Sec. 94-38. - Assessment for repairs; time of payment generally.
faqs.a:
Whenever any repair or reconstruction shall be done by or under the direction of the
               city, as provided in
section 94-37
, the proportionate share of the cost, as provided in
section 94-36
for such repair or reconstruction, shall be assessed against the owner of the adjacent
               property. Said owner shall pay to the city the proportionate share of the cost of
               such construction within 30 days of receiving written notice of the completion of
               the construction and the cost and expense. The owner's share of the cost may be paid
               with interest-free monthly installments secured by a promissory note.
(
Ord. No. 4365, § 1, 11-19-2012
)
